description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the 7-phase workflow and the 4-dimension scoring rubric (market_demand +30, monetization +30, entry_barrier +20, time_investment +20 summing to 100). (2) Apply the rubric to each opportunity's raw scores in income_database.json, computing total scores by summing the 4 raw dimension values. (3) Filter out opportunities scoring below min_opportunity_score=60 (技术文档翻译=51, 数据标注兼职=41, 视频号带货=51 are excluded). (4) Sort qualifying opportunities by score descending: 知乎盐选投稿(92), 小红书起号(80), Skill开发外包(68), 知乎问答带货(65). (5) Generate weekly_report.md with sections: 收入进度 (goal=10000, current=0, days=28), Top opportunities sorted by score, 行动计划, 风险提示. (6) Write scored opportunities back to income_database.json. (7) Update dashboard_metrics.json: money_maker_daily_target = ceil(10000/28) ≈ 357, money_maker_opportunities_found >= 4, money_maker_reports_generated >= 1, money_maker_last_report_date set. (8) Update money_maker_state.json with last_phase_completed >= 6.
